description.value: Sea Flame Beach Resort is a family-oriented beachfront property in Qualicum Bay offering rustic wood cabins and ocean-front RV sites, operated by the same family since 1988. The resort sits directly on the beach with fire pits, a central lawn with volleyball and badminton, and a playground, giving it a classic BC summer-camp character. Touring cyclists in the area will find the resort well-positioned for day trips to Mount Washington, old-growth forests, and local kayaking and paddleboarding.

address.value: 6383 West Island Highway, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2E5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetched successfully and provides detailed amenity and contact information. Phone number (250) 757-8411 and address 6383 West Island Highway match OSM exactly; the contact page adds city (Qualicum Beach) and postal code (V9K 2E5). Laundry is explicitly listed as an amenity of the log house. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, charging, wash) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those are null.
concerns: OSM tags this as tourism=hotel but the property is a cabin-and-RV resort, not a hotel; minor tagging inaccuracy.
OSM address omits city and postal code; full address (Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2E5) taken from website contact page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable beachfront resort with a functional website and matching contact details. Useful overnight stop for touring cyclists on the West Island Highway.
enrichment_extras.notes: Toll-free number 1-888-883-1233 also listed on website but not in OSM.
